name: Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro
author: configurator

sections.description:
Offer visitors a truly different shopping experience and convert them to customers. Configurator Plugin is the perfect opportunity to make your web store stand out! Simply activate and demonstrate the era of hyper personalization!

Features

Customizable Colors and Styles: Easily customize the colors, styles, and overall appearance of the skin to match your website’s theme.

Responsive Design: Ensure a seamless user experience on all devices, from desktop to mobile.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.0 or greater is recommended
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater is recommended

Installation

Manual installation method requires downloading the Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

Sample data

Demo data include in the plugin folder, import kratos-skin.json by clicking Configurator menu, There you can find Import Configurator button, Click that button and choose the kratos-skin.json file from plugin folder and click the Import Now button and wait until it redirects don’t refresh the page.
sections.faq:
Will Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro work with my theme?

Yes! Kratos Skin for WP Configurator Pro will work with any theme but may require some additional styling.

Where can I report bugs?

Report bugs on the Website(https://www.wpconfiguratoraddons.com/contact).

My question is not listed here. Where can I find more answers?

Check out Frequently Asked Questions for more.
